## Orientation

Wave 2 concurrent with suite-engine. Territory ONLY: `dashboard/` (model + app labels/chrome) and dashboard tests. Do NOT edit `skills/`, `affidavit/` runner, or `contract/`. Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--verification-policy`. Commit per task excluding `.artifacts`. Do not call adaptive-artifacts for record writes.

Look up check-run subject `<phase>-suite` (optional legacy `-tier2` read for display only). User-visible labels: suite / suite status (not tier-2 / t2).

### Requirements (R5)

R5: Skills, README, dashboard, and runner rename tier-2 vocabulary to suite/regression; dashboard phase header shows suite status from the new subject convention. This task owns the dashboard half only.

### Design Invariants

- No agent waiver of contracted suite policy.
- No whole-suite per-task verify_command.
- Red-first unchanged for tdd.

### Decisions

- **phase-gate-shape**: contract top-level phase_gate (suite mode/command/gate)
